document_update: Adds the v1 comparison program (Section 6, Appendix E): the v1 core study, wave 2, the selected-rho Causal-ICM addendum, stress study 1, the stress addendum, the TSR study and the CorNet and Integrative R replays. The five earlier studies move to Section 7 and Appendix F with unchanged numbers and assets.

catalog.scope_limit: Original prediction/data arrays and their hashes were not retained;309case reconstruction compares two new repeats and original scalar scores; no full-study prediction replay claim

gp_source_access.uncertainty: Pointwise unadjusted paired t31 Monte Carlo intervals; no new pvalues/Holm decisions

helper_smoke_attempt.independent_verifier: rejected out-of-panel smoke configuration before reading scores; fixed main-panel verification subsequently passed

separate_external_cornet.environment: read-only previously configured Torch environment; same imported package files

gp_source_access.recording_limit: Original arrays and predictions retained remotely;18 fixed first-seed fits replayed, not all576 refit; no fitted GP pickles or complete optimized kernel states saved.

matched_M2.inference: Separate complete Holm64 collection; sample sizes not nested

recruitment.inference: Separate pointwise policy contrasts; all revealed pilot/tuning outcomes charged; subject-only recruitment

native_default_trial_CATE.target: Trial-population full-X CATE; C08 explicitly retargeted from canonical catalog C08
native_default_trial_CATE.attribution: Only GP Full versus GP RCT-only isolates OBS access within an admitted common backbone; fitted hyperparameters may differ.

verification.method: original verified_records(require_complete=False), exact missing-union check and separate analysis
verification.original_verifier: independent trial truth and successful prediction score replay

v1_core.inference: paired t over 64 seeds, Holm at .05 within each recipe

v1_icm_selected.reuse: Seeds of wave 2 and the stress addendum, whose fixed-rho results were read before the plan

verification_limits: Public scalar arithmetic and pinned delivery identities are separate from the original server truth/prediction reconstruction and terminal-JSON export. Neither establishes independent estimator, empirical-data or unseen-mechanism validation.

build.compiler: pdfLaTeX/latexmk outside Dropbox, no shell escape

producer_identity_policy: Each study retains its own frozen producer. File paths in the current input map are relative to this report tag; publication commits do not denote refitted scientific producers.
table_source: v1_program_assets/TABLE_SOURCE.json binds the v1 tables and figure to packet files by SHA-256
metadata_layout: The public-input map and manuscript source/asset map each bind current bytes once. Asset roles reference that map; historical maps remain in the preserved prior report provenance.
